description: This file defines an interface IProfileReader in the Conduit.Features.Profiles namespace, which contains a method for reading user profile information asynchronously.

classes.name: IProfileReader
classes.description: An interface for asynchronously reading user profile data based on username.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a ProfileEnvelope for a given username; supports cancellation via CancellationToken.
